name: Wiki-to-RCQA
intro: Wiki-to-RCQA 是 OLMo 报告中合成的基于 Wikipedia 段落的阅读理解问答数据集。
intro_en: Wiki-to-RCQA is a Wikipedia-passage-based reading-comprehension QA dataset synthesized in the OLMo report.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with OLMo 3 arXiv:2512.13961v2, Sections 3.5.1-3.5.2 and Table 5; official recipe README, prompt templates, and wikiclean script under https://github.com/allenai/dolma3/tree/main/datasets/dolma3_dolmino_mix/wiki_to_rcqa; official data-pool card https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/dolma3_dolmino_pool. Scope pin: Wiki-to-RCQA is a synthetic midtraining dataset validated by microannealing, not an independent evaluation benchmark.. Wiki-to-RCQA is an OLMo 3 midtraining data source, not a standalone benchmark. The official recipe cleans prepared Wikipedia, excludes list and disambiguation pages and invalid short pages, extracts summaries and sections, keeps sections under 300 words intact, splits longer sections into paragraphs, and drops passages below 20 words. For each passage it samples one of four prompts with probabilities DEFAULT 0.10, SPAN 0.25, PPHRASE 0.25, and DROP 0.40, chooses one to eight questions as a function of passage length, and asks Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct to synthesize QA pairs. The pool has 4.22B tokens and 22.3M documents. A 10B-token microanneal incorporating the 4.2B-token source improves the GenQA cluster by nearly two points against a 10B web-only baseline, concentrated on DROP, SQuAD, and CoQA; 3.0B tokens, 3 percent of the 100B final midtraining mix, are selected. No independent Accuracy or F1 protocol is reported.
